card.title: I Meant to Teach That
card.instruction: Treat any correction, surprise, or improvement as evidence your teaching succeeded. Claim each reversal as the lesson you intended all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've improved my filing system. Just the independence I hoped to provoke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yours has found them. The learning journey is complete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did it by ignoring you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My most advanced outcome. I'll include it in the course description.

mechanism: A treats a repaired failed system and rejection of their advice as stages of the teaching they intended.
confusable: Unlike taking credit for skill generally, B's corrections must become designed learning outcomes.
comparison: S221-b incorporates ignoring A into a course; S221-a incorporates exposing A's own consumption into questioning authority.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
